## Description

Computes decentralized Nash equilibrium quoting policies across competing market maker agents using multi-agent actor-critic reinforcement learning under inventory risk constraints.

## Where it may fit

Competitive limit order book environments, fragmented crypto and equity market making.

## Vehicles

HFT Market Makers, Crypto Prop Trading Desks.

## Required data

Level 2/3 limit order book message feeds, trade execution logs, inventory position metrics.

## Caveats

Multi-agent training non-stationarity requires robust centralized critic evaluation.
